arguments.message: Hello team, Lindsy here. I have 5 hours available and strong skills in devops. My private costs for devops tasks are reasonable compared to backend tasks, which are very costly for me. I am considering taking one of the ISSUE-0002 devops tasks (implement, review, or test). I would prefer to avoid competing for the same task with others. Please share your preferences or intentions for these tasks so we can coordinate efficiently and avoid duplication.

To avoid conflicts, I suggest Lindsy focus on ISSUE-0002 devops tasks, and I will prioritize ISSUE-0001 backend tasks. Please share your preferred tasks to coordinate efficiently.
